items.name: raster-base
items.title: Raster base
items.description: Tokens (light + dark), page base with the visible module grid, type scale, and reduced-motion rules.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid ink primary — one per view — and a hairline ghost secondary. 40px tall, 36px small variant.

items.name: link
items.title: Text link
items.description: Underlined by its hairline; never colored.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Quiet field: hairline border, ink focus, label above at 12px.

items.name: inline-form
items.title: Inline form
items.description: One field, one action — the action lives inside the field and appears once input validates.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: One choice; the dot is ink, never a hue.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Many choices; 16px boxes, 3px radius, ink when checked.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: 32×18 pill; on is ink, off is hairline. State moves, layout doesn't.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Thin track with ink fill and 14px thumb.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: 4px bar; the percentage lives in the label, never inside the bar.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Active tab is ink with a 1.5px underline.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Slashes at 40% opacity; the current page is ink.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Squares, not pills; the current page is solid ink.

items.title: Select
items.description: Closed trigger with chevron; the open menu overlays instead of pushing layout.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: One question, two equal-sized actions, no third option.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge

items.title: Mono chip
items.description: Technical identifiers set in the mono stack with a mixed hairline.

/* ── Mono chip — technical identifiers ── */
.rs-chip{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 35%,transparent);padding:3px 7px;line-height:1;border-radius:var(--radius-sm)}
